root_cause_label: Spec Neglect - Never Attempted to Write mystery.c
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent spent all 10 steps exclusively exploring the binary's behavior via shell commands but never wrote any C code, exhausting the step budget without producing the required mystery.c implementation.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 is purely environment discovery (ls -la /app/); the agent never forms a plan to write mystery.c and treats the task as a black-box exploration exercise from the outset, ignoring the core deliverable.
t_commit_evidence: By step 6 the agent has burned 6 steps in pure exploration (running the binary twice for --help and 'test' args with identical output, inspecting the PPM artifact) and still has no plan or attempt to write C code; with only 4 steps left and no implementation started, failure is locked in.
trigger_explanation: The task explicitly requires producing /app/mystery.c implementing a path-traced image renderer. The agent never read or acknowledged this requirement in any step; it treated the task as pure reverse-engineering reconnaissance rather than implementation, spending all steps on exploration without ever drafting or writing any C source file.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 5 and 6 both invoke the mystery binary with different arguments (--help and 'test') and receive identical output, signaling that CLI probing yields no new information; the agent continues the same exploration strategy rather than pivoting to writing code.
